conventions.intervals: both endpoints inside phase; boundary-straddling intervals excluded
conventions.duration: coverage end minus epoch; onset geometry uses exact saved task duration
conventions.timestamps: arrival is local take_latest consumption, not packet/source timestamp

conventions.publisher: all rows lack publish/lateness/last_published; endpoint writer counters unknown
